claims.claim: In non-working elderly households (head aged 60+) in Japan, the deficit of disposable income to consumption expenditures increased from 26,233 yen in 2022 to 34,642 yen in 2023, financed by withdrawing financial assets, indicating growing reliance on dissaving.
claims.dimension: elderly consumer willingness and habit changes
claims.reasoning: This claim is directly stated in the authoritative Statistical Handbook of Japan 2024. Confidence is medium because it provides a snapshot that may not fully represent consumption habit changes.
